Each one\\u0027s handoff follows, in\\r\\ndispatch order \\u2014 the run that opened the work first, its follow-ups after it.\\r\\n\\r\\n[Run 1 of 2 \\u00B7 841ebb4b]\\r\\n\\r\\n- \\u0060tests/Hall9k.Tests/README.md\\u0060 now exists and is the home for test-suite trait documentation; \\u0060Category=PublishesBinary\\u0060 is the filter a cycle gate uses (\\u0060--filter \\u0022Category!=PublishesBinary\\u0022\\u0060), verified with \\u0060--list-tests\\u0060 to select exactly the two publish tests and nothing else. The Windows project home\\u0027s gate can drop its \\u0060FullyQualifiedName!~\\u0060 exclusions for these two \\u2014 they pass in the full suite now.\\n- The non-obvious shape: \\u0060--no-restore\\u0060 and per-test intermediate isolation are mutually exclusive. If you re-add \\u0060-p:UseArtifactsOutput=true -p:ArtifactsPath=...\\u0060 to \\u0060PublishTestSupport\\u0060, the publish looks for \\u0060project.assets.json\\u0060 in a directory no restore ever wrote and dies with NETSDK1004. That is why \\u0060[Collection(\\u0022PublishesBinary\\u0022)]\\u0060 is load-bearing rather than a throughput tweak, and why \\u0060PublishLaneGuardTests\\u0060 enforces it. Task 76174d8a (#280) is restructuring this same test project \\u2014 this branch touches \\u0060PostgresFixture\\u0060\\u0027s doc comment (one appended \\u0060\\u003Cpara\\u003E\\u0060) and \\u0060TestSourceTree\\u0060\\u0027s consumer list, both likely conflict points.\\n- Deliberately left undone: no cross-process gate for the publish. Two \\u0060dotnet test\\u0060 runs out of the *same* worktree can still put two MSBuild processes in one \\u0060obj/Release\\u0060; that is recorded as the open limitation in PLAN.md #155, on the grounds that such runs already raced each other\\u0027s ordinary build output before this change. Also deliberate: the five-minute budget was not raised, and the AGENTS.md pointer was dropped rather than raising its 201-line ceiling.\\r\\n\\r\\n[Run 2 of 2 \\u00B7 e2f09f4b]\\r\\n\\r\\n- **What now exists:** PR #286\\u0027s branch is rebased onto \\u0060origin/main\\u0060 (post-#287) and its full suite is green for the first time \\u2014 4426 passed, 0 failed, 6 m 56 s. The publish decision is PLAN.md \\u00A716 **#158**, not #157; main\\u0027s #157 is the test-tier speedup entry.\\n- **The gotcha:** the two prior gate failures were pure machine contention, not this branch. Both Copilot fixes were already committed locally at \\u0060cf8b13c2\\u0060 but the remote head \\u00602ae9ce58\\u0060 was the *pre-fix* state \\u2014 the platform never pushed because the gate never passed. If you see a remote head lacking the fixes, the local worktree is ahead, not behind; check the diff direction before \\u0022restoring\\u0022 anything.\\n- **Also worth knowing:** \\u0060PLAN.md\\u0060 is uniformly CRLF and git-bash \\u0060awk\\u0060 silently strips \\u0060\\\\r\\u0060.
